description: Krizaka platform updates for a product: one pull request per platform release (@krizaka/* on npm, com.krizaka on Maven Central), labelled, its changelog in the description; patches merge themselves once CI is green. Use: "extends": ["github>krizaka/krizaka-ui//renovate/krizaka"].

packageRules.description: One group for the whole platform: tokens, preset, primitives and the JVM BOM move together.
Patches of the platform merge on green CI (the branch protection still requires the checks).
